entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I need to... I think I need to return something. My VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Sure, it's Mark Sterling. The email is m.sterling88@email.com.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, um, an issue? I don't think it's broken or anything. It's just... it's all a bit much for me. The website made it seem so easy, but I'm just overwhelmed with the app and the settings. I just want to send it back. Can't you just help me with that?
I understand it can be a lot to take in with a new device. I'm happy to check the return eligibility for you. One moment while I review our policy.
Okay, thank you. I was worried it was too late.
Alright, Mark, I've checked the policy. It looks like you received the item 31 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window. So yes, we can definitely process this return for you.
Oh! Really? That's a relief. I thought I read something different online. I get so confused with these things.

Not a problem at all, I'm happy to clarify. Since it's within the 90-day period, I am processing your return now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to your email. Please pack the band in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
Wow, okay. That's simple enough. Thank you so much, Diana. You've been a great help.

You're very welcome, Mark. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. That usually takes about 5 to 7 business days to reflect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
